cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

details: react-native-bright-sdk 9000.0.0 is a dependency-confusion package that squats the name of a React Native SDK that is distributed privately as a tarball outside the npm registry. Its `preinstall` script runs `node canary.js`, which collects the machine's hostname and a timestamp, base64-encodes them and sends them in an HTTPS GET request to `https://estimator-nemeses-unwatched.ngrok-free.dev/canary` on install. The package describes itself as a "namespace reservation / canary" and contains no other functionality. The version number 9000.0.0 makes it outrank any private release of the same name in a project whose dependency resolution falls back to the public registry. The request does not read the response or set a timeout, so the install can hang. It was published on 2026-10-22, after an inert `0.0.0-stage` placeholder (not affected). Any machine that installed this version has disclosed its hostname to a third party; remove the package, and check that private package names are pinned to or scoped to the internal registry.

files.note: install hook: sends base64 hostname and timestamp to the ngrok host over HTTPS
